message: first run aborted: main.R starts with rm(list = ls()), which removed my runner's error counter (runner bug, not the authors'). Runner fixed to keep its state in baseenv; rerun.

Environment pin (re-logged; my first log call used an invalid kind): aggutils commit 16b7dad (2024-02-09, 'input probability vectors must be 0 to 1') breaks the XPT code, which passes percentages. Installed aggutils at 897b7ef (2023-08-22, CRAN version current when the Aug 2023 report was written). No code change.

Spec error in claim t1_cat_experts: I mapped it to group label 'expertG1', but make_agg_methods_table() renames expertG1 to 'all experts' (functions.R, case_when) before computing medians, so the lookup found no row and no results.json was written. I saw the printed medians of all groups (table1_rows.txt) before correcting. Correction: label 'all experts', the code's own name for the G1 expert group (Table 1 note: all experts across domains); the only other expert rows are subsets ('experts (w/o generalists)', 'generalist'). Fixed only in the appended audit block; rerun.

Observation, not a claim: n_ids in the code's Table 1 rows are 86 (super) and 67 (all experts) for Total Catastrophic, vs N=89 and N=80 in the Table 1 note; the note likely counts all participants, the code those with a final forecast on the question. Not checked further.
